definitions: To emit a puff of air or breath, often as an expression of annoyance, impatience, or effort.
To breathe heavily, typically from exertion.
To take offence; to become angry or annoyed.
To make someone angry or annoyed.
examples: She began to huff and puff up the hill.
He would huff whenever he didn't get his way.
The manager's comments huffed the employees.
